preconditions: Calamares owns the mounted disposable target
target is not host / or live /
required_jobs: remove disposable fetian account and home only after proving live-image provenance
remove enabled fetian-live-user.service, provisioning scripts and runtime autologin state
remove SDDM 10-fetian-live.conf drop-in and live display-manager wrapper so normal SDDM starts independently
remove build markers, one-shot image hooks and runtime metrics/session state
remove archiso hooks from normal installed mkinitcpio configuration
generate normal initramfs against installed kernels
configure SDDM with no autologin and retain Sway session
install passworded wheel sudo rule; visudo must pass
validate locked root account, unique normal user, clean machine identity, fstab and UUID-based UEFI boot entries
run scripts/verify-installed.py; any failure aborts installer completion
must_not: delete a preexisting account based only on its name
use upstream removeuser as sole assurance because it never fails
